detail.longDescription:
Come and see the series that’s reached millions around the world. A sweeping multi-season drama about the life of Jesus, seen through the eyes of those who knew Him best. Set in first-century Israel under Roman rule, The Chosen offers an intimate, authentic look at His ministry, miracles, and the people forever changed by His presence.
Watch all seasons now. 100% ad-free, with zero interruptions. Stream on your mobile device, tablet, or cast to your TV. No account required.
What you’ll love about the app:
Easy sign-in with Apple, Google, Facebook, or your email address
Global language support — Enjoy the app in 197 languages, with the show translated through subtitles or audio in 135, all designed to keep language and content perfectly in sync
Choose your subtitle or audio language easily, right from the player
App-Exclusive bonus content — Aftershows, Bible Roundtables, behind-the-scenes extras, and more
Cross-device viewing — pick up right where you left off, on any device
Accessibility-forward design — cross-platform screen reader support, better contrast, and intuitive navigation
- Scripture References — Read the key passages that inspired your favorite scenes, powered by the YouVersion Bible App
In-app messages tailored to you — announcements, event invites, and donation moments that feel timely and helpful
Offline viewing lets you download episodes and watch anytime — no connection required
Powerful search to quickly find episodes, characters, or topics
100% ad-free — stream with zero interruptions
No subscriptions. No paywalls. Just the story — brought to life, beautifully.
Brought to you by Come and See. :heart:
